review_method: AI-assisted source and runtime trace review with mechanical exact-substring checks; not an independent human gold standard
eligibility: Only completed real official queries enter answer-quality denominators. Report execution failure and missing traces separately; never score not_run as0.

patent_answer.rule: Check publication numbers linked to substantive assertions. A question-explicit patent echoed without evidence is not retrieval success.

patent_retrieval.rule: Inspect same-call retained chunks and reference file_paths. For cross-document questions require both patents. Record chunk IDs; list membership does not establish answer entailment.

claim_attribution.rule: Verify each claimed fact against the specific cited Claim, including dependent-claim inheritance. Explicit text in a dependent Claim must not be called a verbatim requirement of its parent.

quote_exactness.rule: Exact first; then only collapse whitespace. Do not silently normalize substantive mathematical symbols/numbers/negation. Faithful paraphrase is acceptable factual support but not an exact quotation.

answer_support.rule: Split answer into atomic factual assertions; attach original patent/claim/character-span evidence. Mark comparative interpretation separately. Never treat polite hedging as evidence.

citation_attribution.rule: Resolve each actual inline citation through same-call reference mapping and retrieved chunk text; assess whether that source supports the associated assertion. A correct document in an unconnected reference list is only source availability.

unsupported_conclusions.rule: Distinguish no evidence from contradiction. Scope negative interoperability statements to reviewed passages.

retrieval_evidence_coverage.rule: Search retained raw chunk content for source evidence clauses, then manually inspect semantic equivalents. Graph descriptions can be useful but are not verbatim primary evidence.

stage_attribution_rules.minimum_evidence: Missing/malformed fact demonstrable in indexed source before chunking; compare dataset source and patent page. Keep upstream defects separate from pipeline errors.

Verify natural exact chunk boundaries and that jointly necessary evidence is separated. This proves only separation. Attribute a loss causally to chunking only with matched extraction controls/model settings/repeated output and alternative explanations addressed.

Source evidence is in the actual extractor input, but relevant entity/relation absent or incorrect in saved raw extraction output after normalization inspection. If extraction output is unavailable, mark unable_to_attribute.

Required entity/relation appears in saved parsed extraction output but is absent/mismerged in committed graph/KV/vector stores. Check endpoint normalization, merged labels, doc status and source IDs before classification.

Relevant evidence/entity/relation is verifiably indexed yet absent from same-call retained retrieval context. Distinguish vector candidate absence, candidate filtering, and context truncation when available. Vector retrieval miss alone is not extraction failure.

Sufficient supporting source evidence is in same-call model context but generated factual answer is wrong, contradicted or unjustifiably omitted. Separate factual error from merely incomplete response.
Answer content may be correct but linked reference/Claim does not support it, is missing, or is unresolvable. Do not reclassify this as extraction error.
Use whenever required intermediate trace is missing or multiple causes remain plausible. Record exactly which trace is unavailable.

comparison_rules: Use identical question text, LLM, embedding, corpus snapshot and total context budget for naive/mix. Record graph-vs-text allocation differences and actual context lengths.
Do not use a later separate retrieval run to stand in for the contexts that produced an earlier answer.
Do not compute or imply statistically generalizable failure rates from this purposive20-patent sample.
Treat omitted genuine dependency chains from both query modes as exploratory outcomes; model stochasticity and budget/truncation remain possible confounders.
